% 改编自本机 PGF 手册中记录的 raw gnuplot 工作流。
% 第一条曲线对应手册里的 `set samples; plot sin(x)`；第二条检验具名常量
% 与用户定义函数。
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[
    width=11cm,
    height=6cm,
    xmin=-6.5,
    xmax=6.5,
    ymin=-1.3,
    ymax=1.3,
    grid=major,
    grid style={dashed, gray!30},
    axis x line=middle,
    axis y line=middle,
    xlabel=$x$,
    ylabel=$f(x)$,
    legend style={at={(0.03,0.97)}, anchor=north west}
  ]
    \addplot[blue, very thick] gnuplot[raw gnuplot] {
      set samples 121;
      set xrange [-2*pi:2*pi];
      set yrange [-1.3:1.3];
      plot sin(x)
    };
    \addlegendentry{$\sin(x)$}

    \addplot[red, very thick, dashed] gnuplot[raw gnuplot] {
      gain = 2;
      envelope(t) = exp(-abs(t));
      set samples 121;
      set xrange [-6:6];
      set yrange [0:1.3];
      plot gain * envelope(x)
    };
    \addlegendentry{$2e^{-|x|}$}
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
